title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First-Day Weekday Rates
content:
The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental first-day weekday rate depends on the rating day of the first-day fee: a Saturday or Sunday is charged **1.2** of the class rate, a Friday **1.1** of it, and any other weekday the class rate itself. The class rate is the class base rate on the rate card; the result is the day-rated first-day fee.

| Rating day | Share of the class rate | Day-rated fee on a Bluegate Cargo Van (class rate 24.95) |
|---|---|---|
| Monday to Thursday | 1 | 24.95 |
| Friday | 1.1 | 27.445 |
| Saturday | 1.2 | 29.94 |
| Sunday | 1.2 | 29.94 |

The day-rated fee is not rounded on its own; the first-day fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end, so a Friday-rated Bluegate Cargo Van fee of 27.445 stands as 27.45 when it is the final fee.
